EXACT SOURCES / DIRECT FROM MOD ORGANIZER 2

Link your MO2 vault.

MO2 already knows many of your real Nexus download IDs. Recover them in one local export, then import the JSON. No account or API key. No network calls. Your installation is never modified.

01Get the exporter

Save the PowerShell script and inspect it if you like. It only reads each installed mod's meta.ini.

02Run on Windows

Run the .ps1 file in PowerShell. Paste your MO2 Mods folder path when prompted (MO2 toolbar's folder icon).

03Import your exact IDs

Select Skyrim_MO2_Source_Links.json from your Desktop below. Only exact-name matches are linked; existing custom URLs stay untouched.

MO2 metadata may be absent for manually installed files, renamed folders or mods from non-Nexus sites. Unmatched items remain searchable, never silently redirected.

✧ Reconcile renamed folders

When your MO2 folder was renamed, match its real Nexus ID to the correct checklist entry. No fuzzy auto-linking, no wrong-page surprises.

Only choose a match if the imported folder really belongs to that checklist mod. Links are stored locally and included in your progress JSON backup.
FIELD MANUAL / OPERATIONS

How to survive the gauntlet

Click a mod row to focus it with a runic selection pulse, or click its circular seal to mark it cleared with shattered glass, magic, and combat effects. Open ✧ Forge FX Studio for intensity, shake, hover trails, and previews. It explodes with your chosen finisher, and the result saves locally. Click the inspect icon to change its verdict, notes, version and exact download URL.

Ctrl / ⌘ K Search the vaultJ Next visible modK Previous visible modSpace Toggle focused rowN Jump to next pendingF Toggle compact Focus ModeEsc Close panel

Live MO2: Click a mod name or use Reveal in the inspector to select and center that exact mod in MO2. Manual clears are practice only; ranked XP and crowns require native version-upgrade evidence plus a fresh full Nexus audit.

Use ⌁ Link MO2 to import exact Nexus IDs from your installed MO2 metadata. Source honesty: verified links open exact project Files or Bethesda Creation pages. Unresolved entries have targeted lookup buttons rather than invented links. Add a confirmed file URL in the inspector to upgrade them.
